body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Bowers & Wilkins, iconic British audio and AV manufacturer, returned to CES’ show floor with its sleak iPod docking speaker ‘Zeppelin’.

Packed with world-leading technologies and finished in stylish stainless steel, B&W's Zeppelin is the speaker system your iPod has been waiting for and the winner of the coveted Consumer Electronics Association's Best of Innovations 2008 Design and Engineering Award.
< AVING Special Report Team for ‘CES 2008’: Publisher and Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Rose Kim, Alliyah Seo, Joshua Shim, Li Coffee, Brain Park >
